final: SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / COUNT(c.client_id) as result FROM client c JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id JOIN account a ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id AND a.account_id = dp.account_id WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK_TYDNE'
